description: An attack and release envelope whose stage times wander from one trigger to the next, the way a vactrol's response drifts, with a separate amount of wander on each stage

params.text: Sets the base attack time, 1ms to 5 seconds
Sets how far the attack time wanders from one trigger to the next, -1 to 1; at the centre it is fixed, positive makes each attack randomly longer and negative randomly shorter
Sets the base release time, 1ms to 5 seconds
Sets how far the release time wanders from one trigger to the next, -1 to 1; at the centre it is fixed, positive makes each release randomly longer and negative randomly shorter
Blends both stages between a constant rate and a rate proportional to what is left, from a straight ramp at one end of the travel to a curved one at the other
Latches automatic retriggering on each press, so the envelope starts a new cycle as each release finishes; switching it on from rest starts a cycle without a trigger

inputs.text: A rise past 1V starts one attack and release cycle and draws fresh stage lengths for it; a retrigger continues from wherever the envelope is rather than dropping to 0V
Changes the attack time, scaled by a tenth and added to the rise knob, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Changes how far the attack wanders, scaled by a fifth and added to the rise stability knob, the total clamped to -1 to 1
Changes the release time, scaled by a tenth and added to the fall knob, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Changes how far the release wanders, scaled by a fifth and added to the fall stability knob, the total clamped to -1 to 1
Changes the curve, scaled by a tenth and added to the curve knob, the total clamped to the knob's travel

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V trigger each time the release reaches 0V

notes: the wander is drawn once per trigger and holds for that cycle; the menu can instead have it move continuously within each stage
menu: Continuous drift (rate wobbles during stage) — makes the stage rate wander while the stage is running, rather than being drawn once as the stage starts
